svg.title: The XOR problem: (a) the four corners of the unit square, with value 1 at (0,1) and (1,0) and value 0 at (0,0) and (1,1), which no single line separates; (b) a two-layer network with inputs x_1, x_2, hidden units 1 and 2, and output unit 3; (c) the two parallel lines computed by units 1 and 2, which unit 3 combines to separate the two classes.
